text: ya so i dont understand why its really a problem. i showed u the floor piece that has the shader right. so they work. it just for some reason they dont on the mesh. but theres no mechanical reason for that
resolution: Answered why the piece looked better and unified it: the piece and ground now share one formula (HEIGHTFIELD_TILE_BODY / tileFill), evaluated per-fragment on the mesh so the painted ground reads with the same crisp asphalt grain + markings the placed floor piece has. No mechanical barrier — it was a flat-color shader + low-res bake + stale pipeline. Committed; rebuild verification pending (see handoff file).
